segments:

    who shall stand-- (
). Standing is opposed to the guilty sinking down in fear and self-condemnation (
). The question implies a negative, which is thus more strongly stated.

entries.title: Psalms 130:4
segments: 4. Pardon produces filial fear and love. Judgment without the hope of pardon creates fear and dislike. The sense of forgiveness, so far from producing licentiousness, produces holiness (
). "There is forgiveness with thee, not that thou mayest be presumed upon, but feared."

entries.title: Psalms 130:7
segments:
7, 8. Let Israel, &c.--that is, All are invited to seek and share divine forgiveness.
